data.name: Location Memories
data.description: As a swift action, you may search your past lives for memories of or insight about your current location. This grants you the scent ability, low-light vision, and a +2 insight bonus on Perception and Survival checks for 1 minute. You can use this ability %1 times per day. You must take this revelation at 1st level or 3rd level.|3+CHA
